title: WealthWise Data Models
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the 14 entities named in BRD section 9 plus RebalancingThreshold (system-design.md 6.1). These schemas describe the PERSISTED row shape: money is an INTEGER in minor units (cents), percentages and drift are INTEGERs in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), booleans are true/false, timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings and dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings. The API transport shape (money and percent as fixed-scale decimal STRINGS) is defined separately in api-contracts.schema.json; the conversion lives in backend/src/types/fixedpoint.py. Floating-point types are prohibited throughout (NFR-01).

MoneyMinor.description: Money in minor units, scale 2 (cents). 2500000 = 25000.00. INTEGER only - never a float or a REAL column (NFR-01).

PercentBps.description: Percentage in basis points, 1 bp = 0.01%. 6000 = 60.00%, 10000 = 100.00%. INTEGER only (NFR-01).

TimestampUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC with Z suffix, stored as TEXT.

Role.description: CHECK constraint on User.role and AuditLogEntry.actor_role.

User.title: User
User.description: Seeded accounts only - there is no self-registration path (BRD section 8, E2-S1 AC5). Mutability: mutable, but no endpoint updates it in v1.

email.description: UNIQUE, stored lowercased. Login identifier and the advisor list's display identifier.

password_hash.description: bcrypt hash, cost factor 12. Never serialised in any API response (E2-S2 AC4) and never logged (NFR-03).

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: One row per user whose role is customer. Mutability: mutable (kyc_verified only).

kyc_verified.description: Stub flag stored as INTEGER 0/1. Its one real gating branch: false blocks rebalancing-recommendation generation (BRD 5.1, E8-S2 AC4). No verification flow, no UI.

RiskProfileAnswer.title: RiskProfileAnswer
RiskProfileAnswer.description: APPEND-ONLY (NFR-02). No update or delete function exists in the repository (E4-S1 AC3). A resubmission writes a whole new set of rows.

question_id.description: Matches a question_id in the active RiskBandRule.questionnaire_json.

answer_value.description: The selected option's value, not its display label.

submitted_at.description: All answers of one submission share the same timestamp.

RiskBandAssignment.title: RiskBandAssignment
RiskBandAssignment.description: APPEND-ONLY (NFR-02, E4-S2 AC6). Never updated in place - both a questionnaire submission and an advisor override insert a new row. Current band = ORDER BY assigned_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1.

rule_version.description: The RiskBandRule.version used - pins the customer to an immutable rule (AC-10).

QuestionnaireDocument.description: Value of RiskBandRule.questionnaire_json. At least 6 questions (AC-01).

points.description: INTEGER only - scoring uses no floating-point arithmetic (NFR-01, E4-S2 AC5).

ScoringRulesDocument.description: Value of RiskBandRule.scoring_rules_json. Contiguous, non-overlapping integer point ranges covering the full achievable span.

RiskBandRule.title: RiskBandRule
RiskBandRule.description: INSERT-ONLY, immutable once published (AC-10, NFR-05). questionnaire_json and scoring_rules_json are never updated; only is_active flips true -> false when superseded. UNIQUE(version) turns a concurrent publish race into a 409 (BRD 11).

is_active.description: Exactly one row is active at any time (E4-S1 AC2).

questions.text: What is your investment time horizon?
How would you react to a 20% portfolio decline?
What share of your savings is this portfolio?
How much investment experience do you have?

AllocationsDocument.description: Value of AllocationTemplate.allocations_json, STORED form. sum(percent_bps) must equal exactly 10000 (= 100.00%), checked with no tolerance (AC-02, NFR-08, E5-S1 AC1).

allocations.description: Each asset_class_id appears at most once. Referenced by id, not by FK, so renaming an asset class never rewrites a published template (E10-S1 AC4).

AllocationTemplate.title: AllocationTemplate
AllocationTemplate.description: INSERT-ONLY, immutable once published (AC-02, AC-10). allocations_json is never updated; only is_active flips. UNIQUE(risk_band, version) rejects a concurrent second publish for the same band with 409 (BRD 11, E10-S1 AC2). Superseded versions stay individually queryable, supporting in-flight customer pinning (E5-S1 AC4).

is_active.description: Exactly one active row per risk_band (E5-S1 AC3).

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description: MUTABLE (AC-03, E7-S1 AC5). target_amount, target_date and priority are editable via PATCH; created_at is never altered (E7-S2 AC4). Change history is carried by AuditLogEntry, value history by the append-only GoalProgressSnapshot series.

target_amount.description: Money in minor units. CHECK (target_amount > 0) - E7-S2 AC1. Guarantees the percent_complete divisor is never zero.

updated_at.description: Additive beyond BRD section 9; moves on every edit.

GoalProgressSnapshot.title: GoalProgressSnapshot
GoalProgressSnapshot.description: APPEND-ONLY (AC-08, NFR-02, E7-S1 AC2). One row per goal per NAV refresh. UNIQUE(goal_id, price_date) makes recompute idempotent per simulated day at the DB level (E7-S3 AC4).

current_value.description: Money in minor units. 0 yields percent_complete 0, never a division error (E7-S3 AC3).

percent_complete.description: Basis points. current_value * 10000 / target_amount, ROUND_HALF_UP, capped at 20000 (= 200.00%) - the documented maximum required by E7-S3 AC2.

price_date.description: Additive beyond BRD section 9; the simulated NAV date this snapshot was computed from.

AssetClass.title: AssetClass
AssetClass.description: Master data. MUTABLE - code and name are editable (E10-S1 AC4). No delete: an asset class referenced by history cannot be removed. Seed volume 5-6 rows.

id.description: Stable - referenced by allocations_json, NavSnapshot and Holding.

NavSnapshot.title: NavSnapshot
NavSnapshot.description: APPEND-ONLY - no update method exists (E6-S1 AC3). Seeded from CSV at startup; subsequent rows created only by the manual advance-a-day trigger. UNIQUE(asset_class_id, price_date) is the DB-level guarantee behind the double-advance edge case (BRD 11, E6-S2 AC2).

price_date.description: Simulated date, advanced only by the manual trigger - no scheduler (E6-S2 AC4).

nav_value.description: Money in minor units - fixed-point, never floating-point (E6-S1 AC5, NFR-01).

Holding.title: Holding
Holding.description: MUTABLE current-position table, revalued by each advance-a-day. Not subject to NFR-02 - history lives in NavSnapshot and GoalProgressSnapshot. UNIQUE(customer_id, asset_class_id). current_percent, target_percent and drift_percent are derived on read and never stored.

ProposedActionsDocument.description: Value of RebalancingRecommendation.proposed_actions_json. Amounts and units are decimal STRINGS so no float ever enters the document (NFR-01, E8-S2 AC6). threshold_bps and threshold_version are embedded so the recommendation stays explainable after a new threshold version is published.

units.description: Quantity as a 4-decimal string: amount_minor * 10000 / nav_value_minor.

RebalancingRecommendation.title: RebalancingRecommendation
RebalancingRecommendation.description: APPEND-ONLY with a one-shot status transition (AC-06, AC-07, NFR-02). proposed_actions_json and generated_at are never rewritten and no hard-delete method exists (E8-S1 AC3). status transitions pending -> accepted|dismissed exactly once; a second attempt is rejected with 409 and leaves resolved_at unchanged (E8-S1 AC4, E8-S3 AC4). No row is created for a customer with zero holdings, with all drift within threshold, or with kyc_verified = false (E8-S2 AC2-AC4).

id.description: Internal surrogate key - never exposed by the API.

recommendation_id.description: UNIQUE public identifier (UUID4) used in API paths, so internal row ids are neither exposed nor guessable across customers.

resolved_at.description: NULL while pending; set exactly once when status leaves pending.

AdvisorOverride.title: AdvisorOverride
AdvisorOverride.description: APPEND-ONLY, audited (AC-09, NFR-02). No update or delete method (E9-S1 AC2). Each override also inserts a new RiskBandAssignment in the same transaction (E9-S2 AC1). previous_band must equal the customer's latest RiskBandAssignment.risk_band at override time (E9-S1 AC5).

advisor_id.description: The advisor's User.id, taken from the JWT sub - never from the request body.

reason.description: MANDATORY (BRD 5.1, E9-S1 AC4). Empty or whitespace-only is rejected with 422 and nothing is written.

examples.note: Discussed on call 2026-09-03; revisit after property sale completes.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: INSERT-ONLY (NFR-02). The repository exposes only insert_audit_entry - no update, no delete, anywhere in the module (E3-S1 AC1, AC3). Queries by entity_type and date range return ORDER BY timestamp ASC (E3-S1 AC4). Also the storage for manual recommendations (entity_type = ManualRecommendation), per system-design.md 6.4.

entity_id.description: Soft reference (no FK) - an integer id or a recommendation_id UUID, stored as a string because it spans nine tables.

actor_role.description: Rejected outside the closed set (E3-S2 AC2).

details_json.description: Ids, enums and version numbers only - no raw PII and no financial-position values (NFR-03, E3-S1 AC5). Sole exception: ManualRecommendation entries carry the advisor's note, which is the record itself and is never written to application logs.

details_json.note: Recommended increasing cash weighting ahead of the client's Q4 liquidity need.

RebalancingThreshold.title: RebalancingThreshold
RebalancingThreshold.description: INSERT-ONLY, versioned. Introduced by system-design.md 6.1 to resolve the BRD section 13 open question on where the drift threshold is stored and versioned. threshold_bps is never updated; only is_active flips - the same pattern as RiskBandRule and AllocationTemplate. Seeded at version 1, threshold_bps 500 (= 5.00%, the BRD 5.1 default). Comparison is EXCLUSIVE: a recommendation is generated only when abs(drift_bps) > threshold_bps (E6-S3 AC4). core/config.py's default_drift_threshold_percent seeds version 1 only and is not read at runtime.

version.description: UNIQUE, monotonic: max(version) + 1 on publish; uniqueness turns a concurrent publish into a 409.

threshold_bps.description: Basis points. 500 = 5.00%. Stored as an INTEGER, not a percent float, so the published value is exact (NFR-01).

is_active.description: Exactly one active row at any time.
